## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install pymlx90642 in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure pymlx90642 package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to pymlx90642
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/ecamo19/pymlx90642):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/ecamo19/pymlx90642.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/ecamo19/pymlx90642)

``` sh
$ conda install -c ecamo19 pymlx90642
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/pymlx90642/)

``` sh
$ pip install pymlx90642
```
